traits.label: MOOD
traits.title: Proactive engineering calm
traits.body: Near-black hero + sparse blue light signals a calm Agent-engineer posture; warm-white mid-page, dark conversion close — controlled, not cinematic.

traits.label: COMPOSITION
traits.title: Split narrative + embedded UI
traits.body: Classic B2B split: copy/steps left, product evidence right; Detect→Fix→Prevent on a timeline rail; FAQ and resources use grid/accordion density.

traits.label: TYPE
traits.title: Single family + one spectacle
traits.body: Geometric sans throughout; hero H1 with cool white glow; closing CTA uses per-character letter-spacing as the sole typographic spectacle.

traits.label: COLOR
traits.title: Dark → light → dark rhythm
traits.body: Electric blue only on timeline dots, tags, and particle art; CTA polarity flips with background (white on dark / black on light); accent never wallpapers.

traits.label: EVIDENCE
traits.title: Real UI over illustration
traits.body: Issue cards, syntax-highlighted code, and severity chips carry credibility; resource cards use unified particle thumbnails, not photography.

traits.label: RHYTHM
traits.title: Seven-beat product story
traits.body: Position → logo proof → three capabilities → resources → FAQ objections → convert → footer; FAQ immediately before final CTA is deliberate pacing.

seed.visualDirection: Dark engineering stage + hairline grid sectioning + embedded real product UI; sparse accent, value inversion, one typography spectacle at close.
seed.dos: Left narrative / right evidence, accordion stepper for long stories, FAQ before final CTA, alternate dark/light canvas bands.
seed.donts: Do not copy LangChain parrot mark, customer logo wall, particle art system, or marketing copy.

annotations.label: Split hero hierarchy
annotations.body: Left copy stack (eyebrow → luminous H1 → body → dual CTA) vs right abstract product graphic. One focal column, not centered hero.

annotations.label: Metaphoric product art
annotations.body: Hero uses stylized dashboard (bars, play node, signal waves) — product metaphor before literal screenshot. Sets monitoring/analytics tone.

annotations.label: CTA polarity on dark
annotations.body: Primary = solid white pill; secondary = ghost hairline. High contrast without introducing new accent hues.

annotations.label: Logo credibility band
annotations.body: Monochrome enterprise logo grid immediately after hero — social proof before feature depth. Two rows, even spacing.

annotations.label: Grid line sectioning
annotations.body: Hairline blue horizontal/vertical rules define feature bands instead of colored section backgrounds.

annotations.label: Live issue card UI
annotations.body: Real product chrome: severity chip, issue title, action buttons. Credibility via authentic UI, not marketing illustration.

annotations.label: Timeline stepper rail
annotations.body: Vertical center line + blue dot marks active Detect/Fix/Prevent step. Left accordion narrative, right sticky UI preview.

annotations.label: Syntax-highlighted code
annotations.body: Evaluator code block with IDE-like highlighting — dev audience signal. Card chrome matches issue UI family.

annotations.label: Muted inactive steps
annotations.body: Collapsed accordion titles use blue-gray; active body returns to near-white. Weight stays constant — color carries state.

annotations.label: Light canvas switch
annotations.body: Resources band flips to warm off-white — mid-page breathing room after dark feature narrative.

annotations.label: Particle thumbnails
annotations.body: Generative blue dot-field art per resource card — abstract family consistent across docs/blog/talk.

annotations.label: Content-type pills
annotations.body: Small rounded tags (docs/blog/talk) above bold card titles — typographic hierarchy without icons.

annotations.label: FAQ split layout
annotations.body: Left anchored H3 + vertical dot decoration; right accordion list. Objection handling before final CTA.

annotations.label: Minimal accordion chrome
annotations.body: FAQ rows = text + chevron + hairline dividers only. No boxed panels — keeps band airy.

annotations.label: Letter-spaced closing H
annotations.body: Final CTA headline spaces every character — single typographic spectacle moment before convert.

annotations.label: Circuit line decoration
annotations.body: Horizontal rules with blue anchor dots frame the closing question — tech motif without animation noise.

annotations.label: Dark band return
annotations.body: Closing CTA restores near-black canvas + white primary button — bookends the page with hero polarity.

annotations.label: Watermark wordmark
annotations.body: Oversized outlined LANGCHAIN logotype as footer texture — brand presence without competing with links.

annotations.label: Status pill
annotations.body: Green dot + “All systems operational” monospace micro-line — operational trust cue in footer margin.

transferableRules.rule: Use dark → light → dark canvas rhythm on long B2B feature landings to pace narrative without adding modules.
Pair accordion/stepper narrative with authentic product UI previews — not abstract feature icons alone.
Keep accent color budget tiny; let value contrast, embedded UI, and one typographic spectacle carry emphasis.
Place FAQ objection-handling immediately before the final conversion band.
Do not transplant LangChain logos, customer logo strip, or particle generative art.
